title: Toilet Paper Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass Freestanding Tissue Holder | Antique Copper | Freestanding Toilet Paper Holders | Allied Brass
description:
Need a toilet paper stand because wall space is limited? This freestanding toilet tissue holder (also called a toilet paper holder or toilet roll holder) keeps a roll close at hand without drilling into the bathroom wall in Antique Copper, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style bathrooms.

Highlights:
- Antique Copper creates an inviting, organic feel
- Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Stays put—sturdy base prevents tipping
- Clean, coordinated look—color-coordinated solid brass tissue roller
- Easy to add to a guest bath or powder room—adds function where a wall-mounted holder won’t fit

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Freestanding toilet paper stand / toilet tissue stand
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 5.5 in x 26 in x 6 in
- Base: Sturdy, freestanding floor base
- Assembly: Some assembly required
- Shipping weight: 6 lbs
- Origin: Assembled in the U.S.A.
- Style context: Transitional bathroom hardware; designed as versatile bath accessories
- Collection: Freestanding toilet paper holders collection
Multiple designer finish options available
